(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means includes a diagnostic feature for monitoring functionality of the first and second valves.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, the plural valves being operatively coupled to the control means.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The air braking unit of claim 1, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, and the control means selectively actuates the binary actuators based on sensor data.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the system further comprises a control unit configured to receive input from at least one vehicle parameter sensor.
